title: Why We Run FreeBSD current at Netflix – Drew Gallatin
summary: Netflix engineer Drew Gallatin explains why the company runs FreeBSD-current on its CDN. He describes the team, how they track upstream, their contributions and performance milestones, and a bug causing a 20% performance regression.
why: HN cites it as the Netflix case for staying close to -CURRENT and upstreaming changes.

quote.text: they recommended both upstreaming and keeping as close to -CURRENT as possible
